evidence.type: Uncalibrated local support and material-budget calculations

branch.notes: Inherited ideal circular branch, assumed E, prescribed F=m*pi*gamma*d. Not measured meniscus force or ski load.

joints.notes: All joint/carrier inputs hypothetical. Two equal disks have radius a/sqrt(2); overlapping disks excluded. Normal spring pads include rotation; Timoshenko arms include bending and shear. Outer anchors rigid within a hypothetical parent grain; no global-grain support proof or adhesion failure model.

grain.notes: Unmeasured parent grain and node counts. Volumes do not prove collision-free 3D packing. Cap applies all added support mass relative to final grain.

budget.note: Inherited pretax hypothetical envelope, not a quote; 2% is a purchased replacement assumption, never an environmental release allowance. Equipment tax-inclusive JPY200M requirement is separate and unproven.

cost.notes: Hypothetical equal price for added pad/carrier; excludes joining equipment/process and stock. Density rises if mass is added; not free reinforcement.
